title: yencoding: encode_all_bytes_round_trip builds an oracle it never asserts
description: encode.rs: the test builds expected_encoded as an independent oracle for all 256 byte values but then only asserts decoded.data == raw (a round-trip). The oracle variable is dead. A symmetric encoding bug that cancels out in encode→decode would pass undetected. Either assert expected_encoded against the encoder output or remove the dead oracle and rename the test 'encode_all_bytes_roundtrip_consistency'.
